source_reference: Saul et al. 2022 Nature Communications, Supplementary Data 1 (SenMayo)
composition_note: SenMayo is overwhelmingly a senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) / secretome signature (chemokines CCL/CXCL, interleukins IL1/IL6/IL8, MMPs, IGFBPs, growth factors). PLAUR's membership reflects co-regulation within this secretory/inflammatory program rather than senescence-specific surface identity; the same program is active in inflammatory/activated myeloid cells.
